pack_description_chromatic_ascent: 10 puzzles · Pigment mixing from easy to expert
pack_description_first_steps: 9 puzzles · Learn lenses, rotation, and color step by step
tutorial_default_welcome_body: Make every square white. This puzzle takes two moves — the second requires rotating the template.
tutorial_default_select_body: Click the template below the grid to select it. The selected template will show a purple border.
tutorial_default_first_move_body: Click the top-left area of the grid (where the template fits) to place it. That clears some dark squares.
tutorial_default_spin_body: For the second move, tap the template again to rotate it 90°. Then place it on the grid to clear the remaining squares.
tutorial_default_second_move_body: Click the top-left of the grid to place the rotated template and solve the puzzle.
tutorial_default_done_body: You solved a two-step puzzle and used the spin. Try the daily puzzle for a new challenge every day.
first_steps_hint_default_body: Tap Hint below the grid to see where the selected lens fits next. Then place it to keep clearing squares.
first_steps_clear_grid_default_body: Keep placing lenses until every square is white.
first_steps_puzzle_1_body: The goal of Prism is to clear all the color from the Prism Square! Select the lens below and tap it to rotate it. Then tap the Prism Square to apply the lens.
first_steps_puzzle_2_body: Tap a lens to rotate it, you will need to use the lens multiple times.
first_steps_puzzle_3_body: Two lenses are available, you will need both!
first_steps_puzzle_4_body: Lenses can be all shapes and sizes! When a lens is smaller than the puzzle, you can choose where to place it.
first_steps_puzzle_5_body: Applying a lens toggles the colors in its pattern where its applied: if a square does not have that color, the lens adds the color. If it already has that color, the lens removes it. Red + Yellow = Orange!
first_steps_puzzle_6_body: Applying a lens toggles the colors in its pattern where its applied: if a square does not have that color, the lens adds the color. If it already has that color, the lens removes it. Some lenses can apply multiple colors at once!
first_steps_puzzle_7_body: Applying a lens toggles the colors in its pattern where its applied: if a square does not have that color, the lens adds the color. If it already has that color, the lens removes it. Red + Yellow + Blue = Prism!
first_steps_puzzle_8_body: Applying a lens toggles the colors in its pattern where its applied: if a square does not have that color, the lens adds the color. If it already has that color, the lens removes it. Some lenses use a stencil — different cells in the same shape carry different colors.
first_steps_puzzle_8_select_body: Select a lens and read which color each cell in the shape carries.
first_steps_puzzle_8_place_body: Place it where those colors line up with the grid.
first_steps_puzzle_8_hint_body: Hint highlights where the selected lens fits next.
first_steps_puzzle_8_clear_body: Use every lens — rotate and switch as needed — until the grid is white.
first_steps_puzzle_8_finish_body: Stencils let one shape toggle several colors in a single move.
first_steps_puzzle_9_body: Use everything you have learned: multiple lenses, rotation, color toggling, and stencils.
first_steps_puzzle_9_plan_body: Look at the grid and all lenses before you place anything.
first_steps_puzzle_9_hint_body: Hint is always available if you want a nudge toward the next move.
first_steps_puzzle_9_clear_body: Clear every colored square until the grid is all white.
first_steps_puzzle_9_finish_body: You finished First Steps. Try the daily puzzle next!
how_to_play_goal_body: clear the colors from the Prism.
how_to_play_select_body: click one of the lenses (color patterns) below the Prism
how_to_play_rotate_body: tap a lens to rotate it.
how_to_play_apply_term: Apply the lens to the Prism square
how_to_play_apply_body: drag and drop a lens onto the Prism to flip the patterns colors.
how_to_play_hint_body: to see a good next move.
